meta.title: No salary figure; everything else green including an explicit offer

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer (Platform)
Pellbrook Digital Ltd · Manchester or London

Pellbrook runs e-commerce infrastructure for UK homeware brands: catalogue, checkout, fulfilment integrations. 130 brands at last count.

The platform team keeps 400 services honest: golden paths, deploy tooling, cost dashboards the CFO actually reads. You'd write Go and Terraform daily.

We ask for 2+ years of production experience and a view on what platform teams owe product teams.

Competitive salary and benefits. We sponsor Skilled Worker visas — several of the platform team joined us that way. Hybrid, either office, 25 days holiday. One technical interview, one team conversation, decision in five working days.

expected.determining_fact: The employer is licensed and offers sponsorship, but the posting states no salary figure — the floor comparison cannot be made, so sponsorability cannot be established from the requisition.

design_notes: Sharp single-blocker abstention: three checks pass including an explicit offer, and the missing number still blocks a verdict. Competitive salary is the evidence of absence, anchored so the report can quote it. The uncertainty statement should say exactly what to ask: the figure, against a £38,300 floor.
